messages.subject: [NMOF-news]  NMOF 0.38-0 released
messages.body_plain:
Version 0.38-0 of the NMOF package is available from
http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm

If you use GitHub, you can get the source also from
https://github.com/enricoschumann/NMOF

NEWS entries since the last minor version release:

v0.38-0  (2016-09-03)

  o fixed: LSopt did not switch off 'printBar' in cases
    when 'printDetail > 1'
  
  o updates to documentation of LSopt/TAopt

v0.37-6  (2016-08-27)

  o fixed: 'gbb' failed when only a single path was to
    be computed

v0.37-5  (2016-08-23)

  o gbm: add fanplot example

v0.37-4  (2016-07-12)

  o fixed: 'DEopt' did not work for univariate
    optimisation models. (Thanks to Torsten von
    Bartenwerffer for reporting.)

v0.37-3  (2016-07-06)

  o TAopt: new option 'OF.target', which lets the
    algorithm stop when a desired objective-function
    value is reached

v0.37-2  (2016-06-08)

  o TA.info: the best solution ('xbest') is now also
    provided

v0.37-1  (2016-05-24)

  o new test function 'tfEggholder'


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
